purpose: Fresh hard-bound decomposition from the accepted 4.4 tok/s strict-cold SOTA path before choosing any new source optimization.

closed_runtime_routes_reconfirmed.top40_or_small_hotset: Top40 decode fallback removal reaches only about 6.9 tok/s at zero overhead; top768 reaches only about 6.48 tok/s at zero overhead. These cannot meet 10 tok/s.
closed_runtime_routes_reconfirmed.all_exact_q80_runtime_current_shape: All decode up/down fallback removal can exceed 10 only with about 1.65s total overhead slack. Existing CPU-compatible Q8_0 per-call path measured 58.687s for up-skip replacement, far outside the slack.
closed_runtime_routes_reconfirmed.source_residency_only: Removing source/H2D alone was previously bounded to leave about 24.5s Q8_0 path time, still not viable.
closed_runtime_routes_reconfirmed.raw_transposed_rowtile_mmvq_hot_batch: Existing raw/transposed/rowtile/MMVQ probes either miss source-bandwidth/transfer budgets or are standalone-runtime rejected in committed artifacts.
closed_runtime_routes_reconfirmed.full_pack_mmap_old88de: Current-source full-pack mmap variants and rebuilt old 88de reproduction are rejected; old 5.1 diagnostic is closed as non-reproducible.

decision.reason: No currently validated exact runtime route has a hard-bound margin to 10 tok/s under 16GB RAM, TTFT, and correctness constraints. Small hotsets cannot reach 10; all-fallback removal has enough zero-overhead ceiling but not enough integration slack for the measured implementations.
decision.allowed_next_without_disk: Metadata-only external artifact refresh or a new hard-bound proving a compact/exact representation with payload far below the raw top4096 requirement.
decision.allowed_next_with_disk_approval: Full alternate GGUF empirical testing with correctness gates before benchmark; candidate order starts with cloudyu 4Expert if enough space is explicitly approved.
not_allowed: Do not rerun per-call Q8_0 strict cold performance.
Do not repeat top768/raw/transposed/hot-batch/CUDA-graph/source-only/io_uring variants without a new hard-bound.
Do not delete or move model files without explicit user approval.
